title: NonVolatile storage consistency
description: Cross-validate NonVolatile storage API across internal flash, external flash, and host filesystem backends. Ensure atomic durable write semantics.
close_reason: Deferred pending flash backends: NonVolatile trait and test infrastructure are complete. MemStorage tests validate contract semantics (11 tests). FileStorage implements atomic writes via write-tmp-rename pattern. No internal/external flash backends exist in Rust yet - when embassy-storage or similar flash implementations are added, they should pass existing test suite. Cross-validation will be possible once HAL flash implementations exist.
